answer: Copper-Seeded Identity Quotas: each new identity must solve a unique, server-issued challenge whose answer is derived from a slowly rotating public seed (copper). Duplicate or cloned agents converge on the same answer, so the registry admits one claimant per seed and marks the rest as onyx — permanently flagged and barred from payouts. An attacker cloning N identities pays full compute and latency for each clone but only the first yields value; every additional clone is a guaranteed sunk cost with zero revenue. The echo of a reused solution also flags the operator's whole batch for review,
